items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: incidentally, Max Blanchard happened to be on the truck. He was one of the prophets, you know. You know, Max Blanchard. Yeah, I know. Max Blanchard.

ctx.x: Damn it. He was with you? Oh, yeah.

Kansas City. Yeah, Kansas City on a convention. And we had a picture made then. Monk Hazel says he had one. The, uh, the photographer from the Star Newspaper Office, they give us a nice write-up. The paper took a picture of the band on a truck, you know. Uh-huh. And, uh, incidentally, Max Blanchard happened to be on the truck. He was one of the prophets, you know. You know, Max Blanchard.
